subject: 48h sandbox uplift request — evening throughput rehearsal
messages:
From: Sahil Patel <sahil@edgescale.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@edgescale.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox window for throughput rehearsal

Hey Hannah / Marissa,

Quick summary of what we need for the next validation run: EdgeScale is planning a 48-hour evening throughput rehearsal next Wednesday/Thursday (US-PST evenings) to validate our failover paths and the autoscaling behavior under sustained 500 RPS for 60s bursts, with a 99th percentile latency target <150ms. This is the final pre-prod run before we flip traffic.

We'd like a temporary uplift to our sandbox quota so we don't hit rate limits mid-run. Ideal uplift: token-equivalent for ~1.2M generated tokens across the 48h window (roughly $3k of usage at your posted trial rates). We can do strict scheduling (start 2028-07-26 22:00 PST -> 2028-07-28 22:00 PST).

Procurement also asked for a short email confirmation of the uplift amount (they'll attach the PO) and any constraints (region, rollback policy). I've attached our stress-plan.xlsx with expected traffic curves and test cases.

Can you confirm availability and whether you need anything else (SLA exception, IP allowlist)?

Thanks,
Sahil
Lead Reliability Engineer
EdgeScale, Inc.
attachments: edgescale-stress-plan.xlsx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sahil Patel <sahil@edgescale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sandbox window for throughput rehearsal

Sahil — thanks for the plan and the attachment. This sounds straightforward to support.

A few confirmations from our side:
- We can provision a temporary sandbox uplift equal to the token-equivalent you've listed (1.2M gen tokens) scoped to your account for the 48h window.
- Region: we will pin the uplift to us-west-2 to avoid cross-region egress differences unless you request otherwise.
- Monitoring: we'll enable per-route tracing and a dedicated dashboard for the run; we'll also set an automatic alert at 85% consumption so we can coordinate if you approach the limit.
- Rollback: if you want an automatic throttled fallback to a lower-capacity model we can configure that; let us know preference.

Procurement note: we'll provide an approval email that you can attach to the PO. Once procurement sends the PO, operations will schedule the uplift and drop a confirmation with the exact start/end timestamps.

Next actions:
1) If the times you proposed (2028-07-26 22:00 PST -> 2028-07-28 22:00 PST) still work, reply with a one-line confirmation.
2) Procure: please send the PO to ops@redwood.com referencing deal RDW-ES-00219.

I'll leave Karthik and Jonas on to approve the promotional uplift and confirm the billing treatment.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks for confirming the schedule, Sahil.

This is an approved promotional uplift: 1.2M generated-token equivalent credited to EdgeScale (RDW-ES-00219) for the 48-hour period 2028-07-26 22:00 PDT -> 2028-07-28 22:00 PDT. The uplift is a one-off credit and will not count toward any reserved capacity or affect committed billing terms. It will be applied to your non-production sandbox environment scoped to us-west-2.

Operations will enact the uplift after receiving the PO as requested. Procurement: please attach the PO to ops@redwood.com and include the reference 'promo uplift RDW-ES-00219' in the body. Once ops confirms the uplift has been scheduled we will send a short confirmation email and a link to a read-only dashboard for the run.

Attachments: promo-approval.pdf (short approval email for procurement), docusign-access-link.txt (if you prefer a signed acknowledgement).

Jonas — please enable the per-run dashboard and set the 85% consumption alert; Marissa, please coordinate the IP allowlist window if EdgeScale provides IPs.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
